text:
anika: Quick sync - sales wants route-reserved slabs + auto-topup. Ops worried about capacity islands.

mira: We can do route reservations but enforce caps and a clear fallback: route_reserve -> account_slab -> shared_pool. No hard SLAs unless addendum.

kevin: Sales asks for auto-topup when slab <10% to avoid customer disruption. Need invoice preview and explicit consent checkbox.

ops_sam: Implementation: router marks billing_tag, serving enforces per-request deduction. Add console toggle per-customer to enable reservations and emergency reclaim. Alert at 75% and 95%.

billing-bot: Created BILL-2201: invoice-preview + auto-topup flag.

anika: Contract language draft: "Reserved slabs are non-refundable, expire per term; purchase does not guarantee latency unless SLA addendum executed. Overages billed at published rates."

mira: Product config example (short):

```yaml
route_reservation:
  id: route_res_v1
  per_route_cap_pct: 0.8
  expiry_days: 365
  auto_topup_threshold_pct: 10
  auto_topup_enabled: false
```

kevin: Sales will want auto_topup enabled by default for enterprise. Require explicit checkbox + invoice preview.

ops_sam: We'll add chaos test for reserve-deplete path and a runbook for reclaim.

anika: Ok. Mira to draft spec + UI copy by next Tue. Billing team to scope invoice-preview.

mira: noted. I'll drop the draft into BILL-2201 and tag reviewers.
